name: lit_petals
source: lit_petals, authored as 12 control points as the albedo of the lit_petals style, in the order the reference's rosette runs from its ground inwards: a deep saturated teal ground through sea-green into the cream and gold outer petals, then orange, maroon and plum inner petals and a teal heart that returns to the ground, so the map is cyclic and a jewel layer cycling it fast never meets a seam; the teal and cream stops are more saturated than the reference's pixels, since the petals' light and the tone pass both pull towards grey.
